answer: Here is one mechanism that works: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because prism only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, fable is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any meadow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
